slides.headline: what to say when someone pings you after hours
don’t start with “it’s fine”
slides.sub: if it’s not fine, don’t soften it first. that part makes the line fuzzy.

slides.headline: name the moment clearly
slides.sub: “i saw your note come in at ten. i’m not online then unless it’s urgent.”

slides.headline: tell them what to do instead
slides.sub: “if it can wait, send it for the morning. if it can’t, write urgent in the first line.”

slides.headline: keep your tone warm
slides.sub: you’re not telling them off. you’re showing them when and how to reach you.

slides.headline: hard for you to say out loud too?

caption:
if you keep answering late pings right away, you teach people that your off time is still open. you can be warm and still set a stop time.

save this for the next “quick thing” at night.
